about: Wording the deterministic rules may miss, labelled with the command Farmhand must reach (expect: the fields that must match; null: nothing may be done - chat, questions, roleplay, or what Farmhand cannot do yet). scripts/model_eval.py scores a local model behind the rules on it: correct, abstained (safe), wrong (an executable proposal other than the label: the dangerous kind). The user, 2026-10-22: a 1-4B model must use the mod reliably.
